eg: It is difficult to measure happiness, so researchers often rely on surveys.
egCn: 幸福很难衡量，因此研究人员常常依靠问卷调查。

eg: Strict rules are necessary to protect children from harmful content online.
egCn: 要保护儿童免受网络有害内容的侵害，严格的规定是必要的。

eg: The most obvious benefit of working from home is the time saved on commuting.
egCn: 在家办公最明显的好处是节省了通勤时间。

eg: Governments must act now; otherwise, the problem will become far more expensive to solve.
egCn: 政府必须立即行动，否则解决这一问题的代价将会大得多。

eg: The number of visitors doubled over the period from 2010 to 2020.
egCn: 2010 年至 2020 年期间，游客人数翻了一番。

eg: Coal-fired power stations produce large amounts of harmful gases.
egCn: 燃煤发电站会产生大量有害气体。

eg: The number of car owners remained stable between 2015 and 2020.
egCn: 2015 年至 2020 年间，车主人数保持稳定。

eg: Online lessons can support teachers, but they cannot fully replace them.
egCn: 网课可以辅助教师，但无法完全取代教师。

eg: The proportion of people living alone rose steadily throughout the decade.
egCn: 在这十年里，独居人口的比例稳步上升。

eg: Older people have a great deal of experience to offer modern society.
egCn: 老年人有大量的经验可以贡献给现代社会。

eg: Schools must maintain high standards even when budgets are cut.
egCn: 即使预算削减，学校也必须保持高标准。

eg: Unlike cars, bicycles produce no pollution and take up very little space.
egCn: 与汽车不同，自行车不产生污染，占用的空间也很小。

eg: Employers value staff who can communicate clearly and work well in teams.
egCn: 雇主看重能清晰沟通并善于团队合作的员工。

eg: It is unclear whether banning junk food advertising would reduce childhood obesity.
egCn: 尚不清楚禁止垃圾食品广告是否会降低儿童肥胖率。

eg: Learning a second language is worth the effort, even for older adults.
egCn: 学习第二语言是值得付出努力的，即便对年长的成年人也是如此。

eg: Nowadays, most teenagers get their news from social media rather than newspapers.
egCn: 如今，大多数青少年从社交媒体而不是报纸上获取新闻。

eg: Around 40 per cent of students said they worked part-time during term.
egCn: 约 40% 的学生表示他们在学期内做兼职。

eg: Schools should focus on developing skills rather than memorising facts.
egCn: 学校应注重培养能力，而不是死记硬背事实。

eg: The majority of respondents said they would prefer to work from home.
egCn: 大多数受访者表示他们更愿意在家工作。

eg: Only a small minority of drivers use public transport on a regular basis.
egCn: 只有极少数司机经常乘坐公共交通。

eg: Parents should monitor how much time their children spend on social media.
egCn: 家长应该监督孩子花在社交媒体上的时间。

eg: Students who lack motivation often fall behind, no matter how good the teacher is.
egCn: 缺乏学习动力的学生常常会落后，无论老师有多好。

eg: The two countries spent years negotiating a new trade agreement.
egCn: 两国花了数年时间谈判达成新的贸易协定。

eg: Numerous studies have shown that regular exercise improves mental health.
egCn: 大量研究表明，经常锻炼可以改善心理健康。

eg: Wealthy nations have a moral obligation to help countries affected by famine.
egCn: 富裕国家有道义上的责任帮助受饥荒影响的国家。

eg: High tuition fees remain a major obstacle for students from poorer families.
egCn: 高昂的学费仍然是贫困家庭学生面临的一大障碍。

eg: Good nutrition in early childhood leads to better health outcomes later in life.
egCn: 幼儿期良好的营养会带来日后更好的健康状况。

eg: Many immigrants have to overcome language barriers before they can find good jobs.
egCn: 许多移民在找到好工作之前，必须先克服语言障碍。

eg: Temporary measures will not work; the city needs a permanent solution to flooding.
egCn: 临时措施不会奏效，这座城市需要一个解决洪涝问题的长久之策。

eg: The government's new housing policy aims to help first-time buyers.
egCn: 政府新的住房政策旨在帮助首次购房者。

eg: Schools should teach more practical skills, such as cooking and managing money.
egCn: 学校应该多教一些实用技能，比如烹饪和理财。

eg: Young people face intense pressure to succeed at school and at work.
egCn: 年轻人在学业和工作上都面临着巨大的成功压力。

eg: The campaign aims to promote healthy eating among teenagers.
egCn: 该运动旨在促进青少年健康饮食。

eg: Some experts propose a four-day working week to reduce stress.
egCn: 一些专家提议实行每周四天工作制以减轻压力。

eg: The rapid growth of cities has put pressure on housing and transport.
egCn: 城市的迅速发展给住房和交通带来了压力。

cn: 合理的；适当的；通情达理的
eg: It seems reasonable to expect large companies to pay their fair share of tax.
egCn: 期望大公司缴纳其应缴的那份税款似乎是合理的。

eg: We must recognise that not every student learns best in a traditional classroom.
egCn: 我们必须认识到，并非每个学生都最适合在传统课堂中学习。

eg: The rise in house prices reflects a serious shortage of new homes.
egCn: 房价上涨反映出新房严重短缺。

eg: Everyone should have access to healthcare, regardless of their income.
egCn: 无论收入多少，每个人都应该享有医疗服务。

eg: Stricter regulations on factory emissions could significantly improve air quality.
egCn: 对工厂排放实施更严格的规定可以显著改善空气质量。

eg: Not all information on the internet is reliable, so students must check their sources.
egCn: 并非网上所有信息都可靠，所以学生必须核实信息来源。

eg: Many older people are reluctant to use online banking because of security fears.
egCn: 许多老年人出于安全顾虑，不愿使用网上银行。

cn: 显著的；非凡的；值得注意的
eg: The country has made remarkable progress in reducing child poverty.
egCn: 该国在减少儿童贫困方面取得了显著进展。

eg: Women still represent only a small proportion of engineers in most countries.
egCn: 在大多数国家，女性在工程师中所占的比例仍然很小。

eg: Some cities restrict the number of cars allowed in the centre each day.
egCn: 一些城市限制每天进入市中心的车辆数量。

eg: The survey reveals that most parents feel stressed about their children's education.
egCn: 调查显示，大多数家长对孩子的教育感到焦虑。

eg: Teachers play a vital role in shaping young people's values.
egCn: 教师在塑造年轻人的价值观方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

eg: There was a sharp fall in sales after the new tax was introduced.
egCn: 新税开征后，销量急剧下降。

eg: There has been a clear shift towards healthier eating in recent years.
egCn: 近年来，人们的饮食明显转向更加健康。

eg: There was a slight increase in unemployment between March and June.
egCn: 3 月至 6 月间，失业率略有上升。

eg: The figures show a steady decline in the number of smokers since 2000.
egCn: 数据显示，自 2000 年以来吸烟人数稳步下降。

eg: Governments must work together to tackle the causes of climate change.
egCn: 各国政府必须携手解决气候变化的根源问题。

eg: Many graduates can only find temporary jobs with no long-term security.
egCn: 许多毕业生只能找到没有长期保障的临时工作。

eg: Rising sea levels pose a serious threat to low-lying coastal cities.
egCn: 海平面上升对低洼沿海城市构成严重威胁。

eg: The vast majority of people in the survey supported the ban.
egCn: 调查中绝大多数人支持这项禁令。

cn: 至关重要的；必不可少的
eg: Clean drinking water is vital for preventing the spread of disease.
egCn: 清洁的饮用水对于防止疾病传播至关重要。

eg: Air quality in the city has worsened as the number of cars has grown.
egCn: 随着汽车数量的增加，这座城市的空气质量已经恶化。

eg: On the whole, I believe the advantages of tourism outweigh the disadvantages.
egCn: 总体而言，我认为旅游业的利大于弊。

eg: The plan has one major weakness, namely the lack of funding.
egCn: 这项计划有一个重大缺陷，即缺乏资金。

eg: The policy is expensive; nonetheless, it is likely to save lives.
egCn: 这项政策代价高昂，尽管如此，它很可能挽救生命。

eg: International trade works best when it brings mutual benefits to both countries.
egCn: 国际贸易在能给两国带来互惠时效果最好。

eg: In my view, the benefits of nuclear power outweigh the risks.
egCn: 在我看来，核电的好处大于其风险。

eg: The needs of disabled travellers are often overlooked when cities plan new transport systems.
egCn: 城市在规划新交通系统时，残障出行者的需求常常被忽视。

eg: Social media can distort young people's perception of what a normal body looks like.
egCn: 社交媒体可能扭曲年轻人对正常身材的认知。

eg: Plastic waste in the oceans poses a growing danger to marine life.
egCn: 海洋中的塑料垃圾对海洋生物构成越来越大的危险。

eg: Graduates with technical skills have much better job prospects than they did a decade ago.
egCn: 拥有技术技能的毕业生的就业前景比十年前好得多。

eg: More adults are choosing to pursue a university degree later in life.
egCn: 越来越多的成年人选择在年龄较大时攻读大学学位。

cn: 强有力的；稳健的；坚固的
eg: Scientists need robust evidence before they can recommend a change in diet.
egCn: 科学家需要有力的证据，才能建议人们改变饮食。

eg: In many dry regions, fresh water is becoming increasingly scarce.
egCn: 在许多干旱地区，淡水正变得日益稀缺。

eg: Modern workers are often expected to handle several tasks simultaneously.
egCn: 现代员工常常被要求同时处理多项任务。

eg: Criminals are using increasingly sophisticated methods to steal personal information.
egCn: 犯罪分子正使用日益复杂的手段窃取个人信息。

eg: Many health problems stem from a lack of exercise and poor diet.
egCn: 许多健康问题源于缺乏锻炼和不良饮食。

eg: Lower taxes on small businesses could stimulate economic growth in rural areas.
egCn: 降低小企业的税收可能刺激农村地区的经济增长。

eg: Banning plastic bags may have unintended consequences, such as more paper waste.
egCn: 禁用塑料袋可能会带来意想不到的后果，比如纸张浪费增加。

eg: There was a sudden surge in online shopping during the holiday season.
egCn: 节假日期间，网购突然激增。

eg: Sales of DVDs plummeted after streaming services became popular.
egCn: 流媒体服务流行起来后，DVD 的销量骤降。

eg: The figures for Japan and Italy were 25 and 18 per cent respectively.
egCn: 日本和意大利的数据分别为 25% 和 18%。
collocations: stood at X and Y respectively

eg: The closure of the factory triggered protests across the town.
egCn: 工厂关闭引发了全镇的抗议。

eg: The city centre is currently undergoing major changes to reduce traffic.
egCn: 市中心目前正在进行重大改造以减少交通流量。

eg: Electric buses are now a viable alternative to diesel buses in most cities.
egCn: 在大多数城市，电动公交车如今已是柴油公交车的可行替代品。

eg: Elderly people living alone are particularly vulnerable during extreme heat.
egCn: 独居老人在极端高温期间尤其容易受到伤害。

eg: Whilst some people enjoy city life, others prefer the peace of the countryside.
egCn: 有些人喜欢城市生活，而另一些人则更喜欢乡村的宁静。

eg: Owing to rising costs, many families can no longer afford a holiday abroad.
egCn: 由于成本上升，许多家庭再也负担不起出国度假。

eg: Volunteering abroad can be a worthwhile experience for school leavers.
egCn: 对中学毕业生来说，出国做志愿者可能是一段很有意义的经历。

cn: 有适应力的；能迅速恢复的；有韧性的
eg: Children are often more resilient than adults expect when they move to a new country.
egCn: 孩子们移居新国家时，往往比大人预想的更有适应力。

eg: Planting trees along busy roads can help mitigate the effects of air pollution.
egCn: 在繁忙道路两旁植树有助于减轻空气污染的影响。

cn: 无处不在的；普遍存在的
eg: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, even among primary school children.
egCn: 智能手机已变得无处不在，甚至在小学生中也是如此。

eg: The city has seen an unprecedented rise in population over the past decade.
egCn: 过去十年里，这座城市的人口出现了前所未有的增长。

eg: When designing new buildings, the safety of residents must be paramount.
egCn: 设计新建筑时，居民的安全必须放在首位。

eg: The decisions of large tech companies are coming under increasing public scrutiny.
egCn: 大型科技公司的决定正受到公众越来越多的审视。
